highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands filtering, culling, and overdraw APIs.
highlights_body: It adds fast paint bounds, modern image-filter composition, and overdraw visualization while restoring small-blur performance. This release also completes the v4 deprecation pass, so review the breaking changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors, run-buffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality are now error-obsolete. Use the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions instead.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration is no longer included
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp NuGet no longer embeds the deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension. Remove dependencies on that extension or provide a separate notebook rendering integration when upgrading.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled rendering engine from m148 to m150 and includes an Apple typeface synchronization fix from the m150 servicing branch.

bullets.lead: Fast paint bounds support quick-reject culling
bullets.detail: SKPaint.GetFastBounds computes conservative paint bounds and reports when they are unavailable, completing the culling pattern with SKCanvas.QuickReject.

bullets.lead: Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes
bullets.detail: SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with tile-mode control, while CreateEmpty provides an explicit transparent-black node for composition chains.
SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps SKOverdrawCanvas counts through a six-color palette for rendering performance diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Small raster blurs regain their faster path
bullets.detail: Native builds avoid the slow raster-pipeline Gaussian path for small-sigma 8888 image blurs.
Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access reuses the managed wrapper and recreates it if a consumer explicitly disposes the surface-owned canvas.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Small raster-blur performance recovery, faster SKSurface.Canvas access, and completion of the v4 deprecation pass

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Completes the v4 deprecation pass, removes the deprecated .NET Interactive integration, and updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds fast paint bounds, crop and empty image filters, and overdraw visualization while improving blur and surface-canvas performance.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with shaping, COLR v1, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.
